newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRADE ON BOURSE'S FREE LIST TO BEGIN JULY 1.
newsitem.headline: TRADE ON BOURSE'S FREE LIST TO BEGIN JULY 1.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange said on Thursday that trading on its official list will start on July 1 with 16 stocks quoted.
"The board decided today to include sixteen companies in the bourse's free list," a stock exchange spokesman told Reuters.
The bourse's free list will initially comprise 16 stocks, applying less stringent information requirements than those applied to companies on the official and secondary lists.

The line-up of the free list includes Kurzeme Lock1, Akta, Saldus Oil base, Liepaja oil refinery, Grobina fur firm, Latvian Bridges as well as Metalserviss, Saurieshi Construction material plant and Veldze soft drink maker.
Saldus, Strenchi, Daugavpils and Talsi forestries are also on the free list, the bourse spokesman said.
Brasa furniture maker, Tukums forestry and Liepaja Fish cannery, earlier delisted because of their poor financial situation, will also be traded on the free list from July 1.
